=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 40-51 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `security_audit_emit_failure` retains its three-parameter signature instead of accepting the provider classification described by the review.
  WHY: The expected provider field cannot be passed to or emitted by this function.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 53-61 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The claimed sanitized-tail handling in `security_audit_emit_path_diagnostic` is absent.
  WHY: The diagnostic helper remains unchanged and does not implement the described sanitized-tail mode.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines ~1170-1173 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The Codex execution failure path does not call the claimed stderr-tail function or pass a provider classification.
  WHY: Codex failures continue to emit only the old path diagnostic and three-argument failure line.
- tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py: three new test functions and MOCK_CODEX_ECHO_PROMPT support | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The claimed tests for Codex stderr tails, provider classification, and secret redaction are absent.
  WHY: The existing test still covers only the old failure path, leaving the requested behavior untested.
- .ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt: ~171 lines of manifest additions | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The claimed commit changes workspace inventory entries while leaving the implementation files unchanged.
  WHY: The review reports that the substantive changes are absent from the source, tests, changelog, and agents file.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 122-124 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The base64-token redaction regex can fail to match tokens ending in `=` or `==` when followed by non-word characters.
  WHY: Padded token values may remain unredacted in the public job log.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 105-127 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The secret environment-variable detector matches `AUTH` inside non-secret names such as `GIT_AUTHOR_NAME` and `CLAUDE_FIXER_HANDOFF_AUTHOR_LOGIN`.
  WHY: Their values can be redacted throughout stderr, corrupting diagnostic output.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 150-157 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The byte-capping loop drops the entire tail when the last stderr line alone exceeds 4096 bytes.
  WHY: The loop breaks before retaining any content, hiding the diagnostic and leaving provider classification unknown.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 57-65 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The sanitized-tail path diagnostic can emit duplicated prefixes and unflattened multiline output.
  WHY: Log scrapers expecting single-line `captured_path_error=` entries receive malformed output.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 163-176 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Provider classification misses bare status lines, `status_code` forms, and common hyphenated or underscored rate-limit spellings.
  WHY: These failures are classified as unknown instead of the required provider status, hindering outage handling.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: On a codex-execution failure, print a sanitized, size-capped Codex stderr tail, never printing raw stderr, environment values, or Codex config; frame it with begin/end markers.
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh — `security_audit_emit_codex_stderr_tail` and the codex-execution failure path
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/security_audit.sh` lacks `security_audit_emit_codex_stderr_tail`; the codex-execution failure path remains unchanged and has no tail emission.
- requirement: Classify common provider failures as `provider=402|401|429|5xx|unknown` on the existing failure line.
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh — `security_audit_emit_failure` and the codex-execution failure path
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The failure function retains its three-parameter signature; the failure path passes three arguments; no provider classification logic exists.
- requirement: Extend the security-audit tests to cover a failing fake Codex that emits a 402 body and secret key, size capping, and success with no tail.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The reported test file has no tail-related assertions, no `MOCK_CODEX_ECHO_PROMPT` support, and no tests for provider classification, masking, capping, or success without a tail.
- requirement: Add tests for realistic provider-status spellings and the identified masking, capping, and diagnostic-format edge cases.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Reported coverage omits bare status lines, `status_code`, hyphenated/underscored rate limits, oversized single lines, padded-base64 tokens, short values from non-secret `AUTH` variables, and sanitized-tail path-diagnostic formatting.
- requirement: Add a `changelog.d/` fragment.
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/5785-security-audit-codex-stderr-tail.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment is reported absent from the working tree.
- requirement: Follow the changelog fragment structure in CLAUDE.md §20.D and §20.G, including a headline, lead paragraph, numbers table when measurable details exist, and audience closing.
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/5785-security-audit-codex-stderr-tail.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment shown in the PR diff has only a marker and a short bullet, without the required lead paragraph, table, or audience closing.
- requirement: Add an agents.md note in the security-audit section describing the new failure output behavior.
  expected_change_site: agents.md security-audit section
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The reported security-audit section has no note describing sanitized Codex stderr-tail behavior.
- requirement: The stderr-tail byte cap must retain diagnostic content when a single final line exceeds 4096 bytes.
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh — byte-capping loop in `security_audit_emit_codex_stderr_tail`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The described loop breaks on the first oversized line with an empty retained tail.
- requirement: The sanitized-tail path diagnostic must emit a single-line, prefix-stripped, sanitized value.
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh — `security_audit_emit_path_diagnostic` sanitized-tail branch
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The described branch greps already-prefixed tail lines and skips flattening and sanitization.
- requirement: Secret masking must redact padded base64 tokens ending in `=` or `==` when followed by non-word characters.
  expected_change_site: scripts/security_audit.sh — padded-base64 branch of the secret-masking regex
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The described trailing word boundary fails to match padded tokens followed by non-word characters.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 122-124 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5

  WHY: Padded secrets may bypass redaction and appear in the public job log.

  WHY: Downstream log scrapers expecting single-line entries receive malformed output.
- scripts/security_audit.sh: lines 163-176 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Provider classification misses bare status lines, JSON `status_code` fields, and hyphenated, underscored, or concatenated rate-limit forms.
